Usage measurement is off by default. When enabled in parent settings, lesson starts and completions, game completions and language pack installations are sent to Google Analytics for Firebase with limited details such as language, game type and word count. The service may also process session data, app version, technical device information and an app instance identifier. Names, nicknames, photos, studied word text and notification tokens are not included in Analytics events. Advertising identifier (IDFA), vendor identifier (IDFV) collection and ad personalization are disabled. Turning this off stops new events and resets Analytics data on the device; it does not automatically delete data previously sent to Google.
